features.quote: Workshops: Konpa, Kizomba, Semba, Afrobeats, Gouyad & more
features.rationale: The description lists workshops in Konpa, Kizomba, Semba and other styles as part of the event.
A pre-party is explicitly listed alongside the official party nights.
Bootcamps in three styles are offered as part of the festival.
The event names a host hotel with a booking link, which is a recommended hotel rather than accommodation included in the pass.
